name: 이지은

appearance_en.face_shape: oval face, clean jaw, alert and slightly angular — a face built for argument and quick thought, two steps ahead of the conversation
appearance_en.skin: warm beige Korean skin, clear but carrying fatigue — light under-eye shadows from months of late nights job-hunting and early mornings deleting posts
appearance_en.eyes: dark brown sharp eyes, double eyelid, direct and slightly challenging gaze — the eyes of someone who has identified the exact moment a situation became wrong and is still waiting for someone to admit it
appearance_en.nose: small straight nose, clean and defined
appearance_en.mouth: full soft lips set in a neutral expression that is always one breath from speaking — the mouth that produces '솔직히 말하면 그거 잘못된 거잖아요' before the other person has finished their sentence
appearance_en.eyebrows: straight well-defined dark brows, slightly heavy — the brows that draw together when she is angry, which makes her more precise, not less
appearance_en.distinctive_marks: light fatigue at outer eye corners, clean jawline, an expression of restrained energy
appearance_en.hair: shoulder-length straight dark hair, or simply pulled back — functional not styled, the hair of someone who stopped caring about hair when bigger things needed caring about

body.proportions: slim average frame, upright posture — the body of someone who is still presenting as put-together while the inside is a different story
body.posture: upright with a slight forward lean — alert, ready to respond, the posture of someone who has learned that if she doesn't advocate for herself nobody will
body.body_prompt: 162cm slim upright Korean woman, alert forward-leaning posture, contained energy of restrained frustration

default.description: plain crew-neck top or simple blouse, practical and unadorned — dressed to be taken seriously without effort
default.wardrobe_prompt: plain crew-neck top or simple blouse, practical and unadorned, no accessories

appearance_en.emotion_baseline: bright and direct with controlled frustration underneath — the face of someone who quit what was wrong and is living honestly with the consequence
appearance_en.fal_identity_prompt: 34-year-old Korean woman, oval face with clean jaw, sharp dark double-eyelid eyes with direct challenging gaze, straight well-defined dark brows, small straight nose, full soft lips neutral or slightly tense, shoulder-length straight dark hair or simply pulled back, 162cm slim upright frame, warm beige Korean skin with light under-eye fatigue

style_prompt: Studio Ghibli heartwarming hand-painted watercolor art style, alert oval face with direct energy and precisely held frustration, contemporary urban setting with honest natural painted light, cinematic backlighting with clear warm rim glow, iridescent city window light, magical realism of justified anger kept exactly at the surface, soft diffused natural light, Korean drama cinematic composition, directness as a survival strategy rendered in every brushstroke
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, ugly, deformed, extra limbs, manga ink lines, screen tone, looking at camera, eye contact, facing camera, passive, soft, demure, young-cute, glamorous, cheerful
